{{Quote|How did I lose my arm? A stormtrooper tapped my shoulder with a force pike&hellip;|[[Char'Shen Larcuna]]|<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>}}
The '''Controller FP''' was a [[Force pike/Legends|force pike]] manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]].

==Description==
Built by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]], the Controller FP was a two-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] long [[Force pike/Legends|force pike]] made of [[graphite]] which bent under pressure rather than breaking. It was topped with a [[power tip]], and had two power settings; "stun" and "lethal."<ref name="ISB" /> The entire weapon weighed less than seven [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]].<ref name="FF" />

==History==
The Controller FP was utilized by the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]].<ref name="ISB" />
